description: This file provides functions to convert database recordsets into HTML tables for display purposes, handling pagination and various data types. It is specialized for generating HTML representations of database query results in a web application context.

methods.name: rs2html
methods.description: Converts a database recordset into an HTML table with optional headers and formatting, with controls for maximum rows and block size.

methods.name: arr2html
methods.description: Converts a two-dimensional array into an HTML table, optionally with headers.
